run_MLP_classifier: run the sent_classif CLI to train an MLP classifier on sentence embeddings with train dev and test data
create_Net_classifier: create a Net MLP classifier with configurable hidden layers, dropout, and TANH or RELU activation
load_data_with_LoadData: load sentence embeddings and labels from binary and text files into a PyTorch DataLoader
test_corpus_with_TestCorpus: test a trained Net classifier on a corpus and print per-class accuracy percentages
train_multilingual_classifier: train a multilingual sentence embedding classifier across multiple languages and save the best model
